# E-M5 III 1.7: card-file debug shell tested

The E-M5 III firmware notes report the method working on a stock E-M5 III, with a live sequencer trace.

**physical camera; pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** stock 1.7 with a card settings file

**Provenance:** firsthand tester report. **Reported:** 2026-11-12. **Test date:** 2026-11-12.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Card file PARAMDT/CP000001.CSV with one line setting 0xF971 to 1; laptop joined the open network and connected to port 23 with CRLF line endings.

- The laptop got an address by DHCP and the shell prompt appeared.
- help listed the 58 user commands.
- take dbgmode 1 streamed the shooting-sequencer trace live; the body shutter worked normally.

## Limits and assumptions

- LF-only line endings get no answer.
- A second connection after closing the first gets no answer until a power cycle.
- The undo check (file removed, network gone) was not reported yet.
